senses.sense_definition: A town in Biscay, Basque Country, Spain, known as the site of an aerial bombing during the Spanish Civil War and depicted in a famous painting by Pablo Picasso.

examples.text: The small town of <w>Guernica</w> became world famous after the tragic bombing in 1937.
Many tourists visit <w>Guernica</w> to learn about its history and cultural significance.
